title: Multi-Scale Attention Networks for Medical Image Segmentation

contributions.purpose: 跨尺度注意力做医学分割
contributions.mechanism: 多尺度编码(s=1,2,4,8)+多头跨尺度注意力+尺度自适应融合
contributions.source_quote: We propose Multi-Scale Attention U-Net (MSA-UNet) ... On a synthetic benchmark, MSA-UNet attains a Dice score of 0.88 (+7.32% over U-Net).

contributions.mechanism: Dice损失(0.7)+边界损失(0.3)组合,专注边界像素
contributions.source_quote: A specialized loss function that combines Dice loss with boundary loss to prioritize accurate boundary detection.
An efficient architecture design that maintains high accuracy while enabling real-time clinical deployment.
